Microsoft Visual C++ runtime files included in this standalone copy:

- msvcp140.dll
- vcruntime140.dll
- vcruntime140_1.dll

These files are redistributable components supplied by the installed Visual
Studio C++ toolset. Their redistribution remains subject to Microsoft's
Visual C++ Redistributable license terms. They are included beside the game
executable because the SFML release DLLs and the game use the MSVC dynamic
runtime.
